title: Magic bytes contradict: LE serializer writes 'E','U','P','P' but the UE test asserts 'P','P','U','E'
detail: Little-endian PutU32 of 0x50505545 emits bytes 'E','U','P','P'. The UE test asserts 'P','P','U','E', so SerializeVersioned cannot pass once compiled; probe JSON hardcodes "PPUE" as decoration.
recommended_fix: Pick the on-disk magic: SAVE_MAGIC=0x45555050 for LE "PPUE" bytes, or fix the test bytes to 'E','U','P','P'. Derive the JSON save_magic field from actual serialized bytes.

detail: No gate writes docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json: the probe gate runs without --json-out and --bless targets the golden path itself. The engine-vs-standalone comparison never executes; gate 8's label overstates what runs.

title: Golden compare omits the rng_first4 field both JSONs carry
detail: Both probe JSONs carry rng_first4 (the pinned seed-42 vectors), but the golden-compare key list omits it. The explicit cross-runner RNG-vector check never happens; only tick_nonce/state_hash cover it indirectly.
recommended_fix: Add "rng_first4" to the compared keys tuple in scripts/compare-golden.sh.

title: FNV-1a-64 'conformance' tests pin no real vector; the determinism check is a tautology
detail: The only pinned constant is empty-input to offset basis. 'Deterministic' compares two identical calls (always true); nonzero/order-sensitive pass for nearly any hash. A wrong FNV implementation passes both runners.
recommended_fix: Pin published FNV-1a-64 test vectors (e.g. "a", "foobar" from the FNV reference) in both tests/spine_check.cpp and PP_HashTests.cpp.

title: Spine headers' one-line braced ifs conflict with the committed Allman .clang-format; format gate never ran
detail: Committed .clang-format pins BreakBeforeBraces: Allman, but the spine headers use single-line braced ifs. The format gate has only ever SKIPped (timings.md), so the conflict is undetected and will churn Source/ on the first real run.
recommended_fix: Run clang-format over Source/ before the first engine-gated run, or soften the config (AllowShortBlocks/AllowShortIfs settings) to match the committed style.

title: Format gate labeled 'ENGINE:' despite format-check.sh's engine-free system clang-format fallback

detail: format-check.sh explicitly falls back to a system clang-format (engine-free), yet local-ci.sh treats the gate as engine-gated via the 'ENGINE:' label — so engine-less machines with clang-format installed never run it.

title: 'Mirrors tests/spine_check.cpp' claim is one-way: SerializeVersioned has no standalone counterpart

recommended_fix: Port the serialization/magic-byte checks into tests/spine_check.cpp so both runners assert identical bytes.
